commands.author: clawsweeper[bot]
commands.review_summary:
Adds a macOS 26 `chat-background` CLI/RPC probe surface for reading background state and clearing existing backgrounds, while making background creation fail closed, plus docs and tests.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review finding: source inspection shows the CLI/RPC `set` paths now throw unsupported errors while `docs/rpc.md` still says `chats.setBackground` sets from a file/path.
commands.review_followup: - A narrow docs correction can make the PR internally consistent without maintainer product judgment.

target.title: feat: add chat background probes
target.body:
## Summary
- add `imsg chat-background status` to inspect native macOS 26 transcript-background state from the local Messages DB
- keep the proven `imsg chat-background clear` bridge path for removing an existing native background
- make `imsg chat-background set` and RPC `chats.setBackground` fail fast instead of reporting false success
- keep `chats.removeBackground` available over RPC; remove `chats.setBackground` from advertised `rpc_methods`

## Current Feature State
Supported in this PR:
- `imsg chat-background status --chat ... --json`
- `imsg chat-background clear --chat ... --json`
- RPC `chats.removeBackground`

Not supported in this PR:
- creating/setting a new background from an arbitrary file. Native Messages writes PosterKit/channel-backed state, not just an IM file transfer. The previous set probe returned bridge success but did not produce a visible background, so this branch now rejects set explicitly.

## Redacted Proof
Proof target was the Lobster test group, redacted here as `any;+;[group-guid]`. Local proof artifacts are under:
`/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-09/167-chat-backgrounds/`

Native UI set proof, then `status` from this branch:
```json
{"ok":true,"chat_id":22,"chat_guid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_set":true,"background_channel_guid":"CB37D1F8-FA4A-4991-9197-38ECA08C4DB0","cache_exists":true,"watch_background_exists":true,"poster_version":1,"file_size":452671,"latest_event":{"row_id":6796,"guid":"CB37D1F8-FA4A-4991-9197-38ECA08C4DB0","action":"set","date":"2026-07-09T17:52:53Z"}}
```

Clear proof from the bridge path:
```json
{"selector":"setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:","chatGuid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_cleared":true}
```

DB state after clear:
```text
backgroundChannelGUID=None
backgroundProperties={"trabav":805311742375045760}
latest background event: item_type=3 group_action_type=6
```

Visual proof:
- Omar confirmed the native background disappeared after `imsg chat-background clear`.
- Omar then set a new Sky background through native Messages UI; `imsg chat-background status` detected the new `background_channel_guid`, cache files, and set event.

Unsupported set proof:
```text
$ ./bin/imsg chat-background set --chat 'any;+;[group-guid]' --file /tmp/bg.png
chat-background set is not implemented: native backgrounds require PosterKit channel state; use status or clear
```

## Verification
- head: `960130e`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `swift build` ✅
- `make build` ✅ (existing warnings only: SQLite module-cache rebuild note, deprecated `NSKeyedUnarchiver unarchiveObjectWithData:`)
- `make test` ❌ local toolchain blocked before tests execute: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`

## Notes
- This remains macOS 26-gated and fail-closed.
- Status output intentionally omits/redacts sensitive PosterKit transfer key/signature fields from `chat.properties`.
